original.statement: A bug fix makes the notifications "on deployed" trigger consider a race between last transition time and sync finished time; the evidence does not say what operators must do.

corrected.statement: The on-deployed trigger now accounts for a race between the last transition time and the sync finished time when deciding whether to fire (bug fix).

decision.reason: The bug-fix line [ev-9337091e0b36] says the "On deployed trigger" must now take into account a race between the last transition time and the sync finished time. That supports behavior-changed on the trigger's behaviour. However, the text never names a "notifications" component, so that field comes from outside knowledge. Also, "race" describes the bug, not the subject, so the shortest unambiguous name is "on-deployed-trigger".
